story_summary: A solitary performer, feeling lost and insignificant in the twilight streets of Paris, channels her deep sorrow into a powerful, defiant dance. As a storm breaks, she embraces the wind and rain, transforming the cityscape into her stage and her pain into a breathtaking spectacle of resilience.

characters.name: The Performer
characters.visual_design: A young woman with expressive, sorrowful eyes and windswept dark hair, wearing a striking, tailored crimson velvet coat over a simple dark dress.

story_beats.title: A Sweet Suffering
story_beats.description: Feeling like an unimportant being, the Performer stands hunched and forlorn at the top of rain-slicked Parisian steps, clutching her coat as the first drops of rain begin to fall under a dramatic sunset.

story_beats.title: Stirring the Heavens
story_beats.description: Her expression shifts from sorrow to determination. She extends one arm gracefully, taking her first defiant dance step down the stone stairs, beginning to move the world around her.

story_beats.title: The Dance with the Storm
story_beats.description: At the peak of her dance, she leaps into the air in a whirlwind of motion. Her crimson coat flares out as the wind and rain swirl around her in a vortex of raw, untamed emotion.

story_beats.title: Final Freeze-Frame
story_beats.description: The dance concludes. She stands poised and powerful at the bottom of the steps, head held high, looking directly forward with a triumphant gaze as the storm subsides behind her.

panels.caption: Oh ma douce souffrance... pourquoi s'acharner ?
Je ne suis qu'un être sans importance...
Je remue le ciel, le jour, la nuit...
Je danse avec le vent, la pluie...
